census_cards_carried: Rocky Helmet x2 [A2 148] (census group 4: priced by kt switch 3 as counter damage; not a switch-1 damage-cut card)
selection_rule: B2e rule: best placing first, larger event as the tiebreaker; the list must carry at least one census card; development-half entries only (rl/results/kt_carrier_census_2026-09-26/carrier_entries.csv rows for this archetype).
selection_note: 17 carrier entries of this archetype in development-half events (every one carries 2 Rocky Helmet A2 148 and nothing else from the census set; none carries a switch-1 card). ravenoussix's 7th of 113 (6-2-1, Sept 1) is the best placing outright, so no tiebreak was needed. The only 18th list of this name in the development half is tababahani's 29th of 113 at the same event (4-3-0), which runs Mars and Red Card in place of Rocky Helmet and is not a carrier, so it was not eligible. The literal largest event is PMPT #44 (378 players, Aug 29), where breaking2mirror placed 90th (4-3-0) with a carrier list; placing comes first under the rule, so it was not used.
